label: Dead Air
summary: You host the overnight show on the town's tiny radio station. At 3 a.m., a caller who died last winter asks for a song.
title: Dead Air
description: The snow has closed the road. The phone lines are down. And at 3 a.m. the studio phone rings anyway, with a voice everyone in town buried last winter.

chapterOutlines.title: The Graveyard Shift
chapterOutlines.outline: The impossible call, the request, and the first sign that someone else is listening.

chapterOutlines.title: Frequencies
chapterOutlines.outline: Find out who else heard the broadcast, and what they are not saying.

chapterOutlines.title: First Light
chapterOutlines.outline: Something wants to come in from the snow before morning.

scene.location: The KHPR studio in the old fire lookout above town
scene.summary: Three in the morning, snow against the windows. The request line is blinking, though the phones have been dead since dusk.

openThreads: Who is really on the line?
Why did the phones go dead at dusk?

npcs.name: Dell Harker
npcs.description: Brings coffee up to the lookout every night at two. Tonight he is late.
goals: Get everyone in town through the winter
abilities: Knows every trail in the forest

relationships.label: Friend
relationships.status: Worried about you up there alone
